title: The BIGGEN BENCH: A Principled Benchmark for Fine-grained Evaluation of Language Models with Language Models
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Safety' as one of the nine core capabilities it benchmarks. This capability explicitly includes tasks for evaluating 'Moral Belief' and 'moral dilemmas', as well as ensuring models do not make unethical decisions based on religion, race, or gender. This goes beyond a standard ethical considerations section by actively measuring these traits as performance metrics.
